# App Skills — paste-ready content for DepositCraft

## Skill name field

DepositCraft assistant skill

## Guidelines field

DepositCraft (@krasalgim/depositcraft) manages deposit and layaway payment plans for checkout.

Use DepositCraft's App Tools when a site collaborator asks, in natural language, about DepositCraft's current plan, whether its storage is set up, or how many configuration records it holds. Prefer these tools over guessing from the dashboard UI screenshots the assistant may have seen, since they read live data.

Available tools:
- `get-entitlement`: Returns the current DepositCraft plan entitlement for this site instance, including whether Pro features are active.
- `verify-storage`: Checks whether DepositCraft private Wix Data storage is provisioned on this site.
- `describe-config`: Summarizes how many DepositCraft configuration records exist in private storage.

Never claim a Pro-only DepositCraft capability is available for a free instance — call `get-entitlement` first and defer to its `isPaid` value. If `verify-storage` reports storage is not ready, tell the user to reopen the app dashboard, which shows setup progress and recovers automatically; do not attempt to provision storage yourself.

## Allowed App Tools (select these methodNames)

- get-entitlement
- verify-storage
- describe-config
